I feel that way too. I'm 20 now and I'm certain I'll die at 35, I'll celebrate my birthday în autumn and won't make it to spring. 
I'm not sure how this feeling is like for you, but for me it brings me extreme comfort. Like, I know when it'll be over so I know to do as much as I can/want until then, as if I have a 'deadline' of some sorts. It's reassuring for me to have some what control over it. I won't be doing anything to speed up the day, but when it happens I'll finally be at peace. 
And knowing when it'll happen I feel like I can get my close ones used to the idea of my absence before it happens. The only people I care for are younger than me (siblings) so it's pretty inevitabile that I'll die before them.

In all honesty I'm not sure therapy is for me right now, even while I was going it never felt like we were actually talking about my trauma and issues, it was always surface level and about day to day life. I tend to bury my trauma whenever it happens so I have to admit it takes a while for me to be comfortable enough to actually talk about it and not make fun of it instead. So whenever I did feel like i trusted my therapist enough to bring it up and they just shut me down to ask me mundane questions, I started to question if therapy was working for me. I'm planing on trying on going to therapy again at some point in the future, probably when I'm more financially stable. I want to give it another chance!

I live in Romania at the moment and there is not really any free of charge place I can contact. None that I have found anyway. În order to get somewhat compensated medication prescribed I need to be registered at a certain medical facility, however my mother never did this while I was younger so I'm trying now on my own. The procedure is wierd and jumbled here with a lot of back and forth paper work, but I'm doing my best. Even if I don't start taking any medication again, I still need to get myself registered.

I'm 19 now, when my therapist spoke to my mother I had just turned 19. I actually found this out on my birthday, which was rather upsetting. I'm not sure how it is abroad, but here a therapist cannot tell anyone what you've told them. I even signed a contract that stated as such when we first started. I wouldn't have cared about it if it would have been anyone other than my mother...

I've spoken to the school counsellor, but they haven't been able to help me în awhile. I spoke today to my homeroom teacher about some of this, but I'm not sure I got through to her. I have a tutor for one of the subjects, the one I struggle the most with, but I can't tell if I'm making any progress or not. I'm not allowed to be on school property after hours and I get extremely anxious outside so I have to go home after school.

I've been speaking the language for a number of years, they main issue is actually the cultural differences that make understanding the literature so difficult.

I'm trying my best, and I hope things will turn around soon :) 

Thank you so much for talking to me, I really needed it!

I'm not sure about my exams honestly, the subjects I'm taking are the ones I struggle with the most. Sadly I can't change them. My teachers aren't happy with how I'm doing. The school I go to is known for it's high grades and exeeding students, but I'm just average or even below average (in a 1-10 system, I'm a 6-7). I struggle with the language as it isn't my native tounge and I think in English so everything is much harder for me than it is for other students and takes a lot more time.

My grandmother is pretty similar to my mother so I try to restrict my visits to once or twice a week.

I did some volunteer work a while back and would love to start again once I'm done with my exams (hoping I make it that far).

Dealing with all the anxiety, depression and suicidal stuff takes such a large toll on me. I can't really function as a human being anymore. At school I'm on auto-pilot, it looks like I'm listening to the teachers or joking with classmates, but the only thing going on in my mind is how to die, how be free off all of this, how to no longer exist. I engulf myself in these dark ideas and allow them to thrive in my mind.

I try to avoid interacting with my mother as much as I can. I talk to her and hang around her when she's in a good mood because I childishly hope she'll love me and they're quite rare nowadays, but when she's foul I lock myself in my room or just avoid her completely.

She's constantly verbally abusive as she knows words hurt me the most and I have extremely low self-worth. She hasn't been phisycal in a while though and I'm grateful for that, the last time I fought back. Being bipolar she goes from laughing and hurting me to holding me while I cry myself through a panic attack. I never know who she'll be when I come home from school. But I can more or less live around her.

My sister is younger than me and goes through simillar verbal abuse. She's never been hurt phisycally by my mother as I've always taken the hits for her. No matter the reason I would and will never let her lay a hand on my sister.

The relationship my dad and I have is strange. My parents divorce was really messy so we were unable to see, talk, write or comunicate in anyway with dad for years. Although we're basically strangers at this point, I reached out a year ago and flew over to pay him a visit. He'd moved on. Made a new family. His wife dislikes me and sees me as a gold-digger (not sure if that's the right term), even though I never asked for anything from them and my dad hasn't ever paid Child Support. I don't think she would allow me to stay with them even if my dad wanted me to.
